_about: Composers left out of the chamber section entirely, with the reason. The section includes composers whose works have a track record of being performed and taken seriously by professional musicians (docs/chamber-music-plan.md, decision 1). scripts/chamber/imslp_census.ts puts their IMSLP pages out of scope; curation agents propose further names in their output's exclude_composers, and the owner decides.
Owner, 2026-10-16: not a composer with a professional track record (500 self-uploaded works on IMSLP, none performed or recorded by professional musicians)
